versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "patent-transfer" skill.

- Generates a technology transfer intelligence report in HTML based on input patent numbers.
- Integrates patent search, semantic search, company intelligence, and news modules to assess patent value and identify potential transferees.
- Provides structured analysis of key patent package metrics, candidate companies, and actionable suggestions.
- Supports automated, branded reporting with dynamic content placeholders and a ready-to-push HTML template.
- Tailored for efficient, data-driven patent asset transfer workflows.
